## What changes

Describe the visible change and why it is needed.

## Review link or screenshots

Include a non-production preview or screenshots for visual changes. If this is documentation/workflow-only, say so.

## Validation

- [ ] Static preview checks and JavaScript syntax check pass.
- [ ] Desktop and mobile layouts reviewed, or not applicable to this change.
- [ ] Links, maps, and affected interactions reviewed, or not applicable.

## Release agreement

Record public-safe approval confirmations before merging. Keep private client communications outside this public repository. Leave pending items unchecked.

- [ ] Marvin agrees this release is ready.
- [ ] Walt agrees this release is ready and confirms the production deployment target.
- [ ] Client approval is recorded, or explicitly confirmed not applicable to a workflow-only change.

Merge into `main` only after the applicable approvals are complete. These checkboxes are a manual agreement record. GitHub also enforces an approving review, passing validation, an up-to-date branch, and resolved conversations.
